description.narrative: CFAMM: Foreign Affairs Ministers Meeting to collectively address global issues such as climate change, economic instability, and threats to democracy, working towards a more resilient and sustainable future for all member countries. CFAMM typically takes place in New York in the margins of the United Nations General Assembly in September. This budget cycle, the meeting is projected to take place in March 2026 in London. CMAG: Support to convening the Ministerial Action Group and strengthening its capacity to proactively engage with member countries, promoting adherence to democratic principles and facilitating inclusive political dialogue and governance.
